text.autoconfig.keepinveverywhere.title: Take it Anywhere Settings
text.autoconfig.keepinveverywhere.option: Keep your items when you die, independent of the keepInventory game rule.
When keeping inventory, also keep your experience levels.
Ask for confirmation before overwriting a slot or your current inventory.
Also copy armor stands, item frames and animals when saving/pasting builds.
AUTO follows the game language; ENGLISH/GERMAN force the mod's UI language.
